correctness.rationale: Unimodular matrix identity equates zero indices to scalar powers, proving divisibility of zero positions, period-rank quotient at most two, and exact lcm laws. For even a the first zero and period modulo 2^(nu_2(a)+1) are both 4. The exact triple-index identity yields odd first zero index for each 3^j; period reduction modulo 3 forces doubled period. Thus the combined lcm has equal period and rank. All integer quantifiers are proved without reliance on a finite cutoff; the packaged checker independently tests examples.
